{# Main layout: table + side panel #}
{# LEFT: Table Card — uses workbench_table macro. min-w-0 overrides the flex item's default min-width:auto -- without it, a flex child containing a wide table cannot shrink below the table's intrinsic width, so the browser can't compute a correct scroll boundary for the table's own overflow-x-auto container. The visible symptom (H3) was the sticky "Actions" column's right:0 anchor landing mid-table instead of at the real scrolled edge, overlapping Status/Contract. #}
{# Two empty states, chosen by hasActiveFilters (search or a filter is applied): nothing exists yet, or nothing matches what was asked for. The shared table only takes static text, so the message and the action are passed as markup and bound here. #} {# data-testid/role match the house empty-state convention used elsewhere, e.g. archimate_crud/partials/_repository_workspace.html's true/filtered empty states. #} {% set _vendor_empty_title %} {% endset %} {% set _vendor_empty_action %} {# Distinct accessible name from the header's own "Add Vendor" action (page_header's `actions=`, above): both are visible together whenever the table is empty, and identical names made get_by_role('button', name='Add Vendor') ambiguous -- caught by tests/smoke/test_vendor_dialog_controls.py, whose own selector is (rightly) unscoped since it targets the header action specifically. #} {% call button(type='button', variant='default', aria_label='Add your first vendor', attrs={'@click': "Platform.modal.open('create-vendor')"}) %}Add your first vendor{% endcall %} {% call button(type='button', variant='outline', aria_label='Clear filters', attrs={'@click': 'clearAllFilters()'}) %}Clear filters{% endcall %} {% endset %} {% call workbench_table( columns=[ {'key': 'row_number', 'label': '#'}, {'key': 'name', 'label': 'Vendor', 'sortable': true}, {'key': 'system_count', 'label': 'Systems'}, {'key': 'annual_cost', 'label': 'Annual cost'}, {'key': 'next_renewal', 'label': 'Next renewal'}, {'label': 'Actions', 'align': 'right'}, ], filters=[], selectable=true, search_placeholder='Search vendors...', empty_icon='building', empty_message=_vendor_empty_title, empty_description=_vendor_empty_action, per_page_default=25 ) %} {# ── Page-specific cell templates (repeated per row by Alpine x-for) ── #} {% call table_cell(class='px-3 align-middle tabular-nums text-muted-foreground text-sm', attrs={'x-text': 'row.row_number'}) %}{% endcall %} {% call table_cell(class='px-4 py-3 align-middle') %}

{# RIGHT: Products side panel. showVendorProducts() (js/vendors/list.js) is what reveals it (adds lg:block), but nothing on this page currently calls it — no row carries data-vendor-id, and the vendor-name button opens the edit modal instead. That gap predates this fix and is not addressed here; this change only concerns the wrapper's own default state. The wrapper must NOT carry lg:block itself while hidden, or an empty bordered box reserves 288px from 1024px up and squeezes the table into a scrolled, overlapped state — which is the bug this PR fixes. #}
